newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Death toll in Indonesian bus plunge rises to 20.
newsitem.headline: Death toll in Indonesian bus plunge rises to 20.

text.p: The death toll in an Indonesian bus crash rose to 20 on Monday as police attempted to identify some of the victims of Sunday's accident, police officials said.

The official Antara news agency said on Sunday that 15 passengers, including a number of small children and the 23-year-old driver, were killed and 28 were injured when the bus rolled down into a gorge in West Java.
Police said that as of Monday morning seven victims remained unidentified.

They said the bus fell into a gorge just after midday on Sunday near the village of Cijapati, about 60 km (40 miles) southeast of the provincial capital of Bandung, as it tried to negotiate a steep curve.
It rolled several times down the embankment before coming to a stop, police said. The injured had been taken to the general hospital in nearby Garut.

Millions of Indonesians are travelling on the country's roads as they return to their home towns and villages to celebrate the Moslem Eid al-Fitr holiday, which marks the end of the Ramadan fasting month.
Sunday and Monday are national holidays in Indonesia, the world's largest Moslem country.
